transcript.text: Good afternoon, everyone. We have 120 returned servo drives from the customer up for possible remanufacture. Let's work through our standard 15:00 disposition huddle. I'll call on each of you in turn — Quality, Environmental Health and Safety, and Remanufacturing — for your go-or-no-go updates before I sign off on the work order. Quality, can you start us off with your findings?

transcript.text: I've completed the serial-number reconciliation. Exactly 96 of the 120 returned drives have complete service histories and are eligible for remanufacture.
